task.title: Filter schedules by lifecycle status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/803 with an exact read-only status projection over authoritative inventory.
acceptance_criteria: Return only schedules whose persisted status exactly matches the caller-owned filter.
Preserve exact schedule-ID ordering and return an empty list when no schedule matches.
Reuse snapshot-consistent discovery, fail-closed replay, and unrelated-stream exclusion.
Perform no append, clock read, claim, release, materialization, dispatch, execution, permission, or recovery decision.

attempts.diagnostic: The targeted integration test failed because ScheduleStore::list_by_status did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added all-status matching, exact-ID ordering, empty-match, and fail-closed behavior assertions.

attempts.summary: Implemented the smallest direct status filter.
attempts.diagnostic: Callers otherwise had to duplicate lifecycle filtering, but a new persisted index or query abstraction was not justified.
attempts.patch: Filtered the existing authoritative schedule vector by exact projected status and retained its established ordering.

attempts.summary: Reviewed and verified the read-only boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive exact-head hosted review generated no actionable comments.
attempts.patch: Kept the projection direct, updated ADR and scheduler docs, and reran repository-wide verification.

outcome.summary: Callers can now inspect exact pending, cancelled, claimed, or materialized inventory without duplicating filtering or gaining lifecycle authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test schedule_store

lessons: Common operational filters belong beside authoritative discovery when their semantics are exact and stable.
A read-only projection must not be confused with authorization to mutate the returned aggregates.
Preserve established deterministic ordering after filtering instead of re-sorting under a new policy.
Do not add a generalized query abstraction for one proven exact-status operation.
The substantive exact-head hosted review generated no actionable comments, so no review-driven follow-up was required.
